page.overview:
What is Better than You?

Better Than You is the fifth song from the 1997 album ReLoad. It was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich and has a length of 5:21. It doesn't appear in any single released by Metallica.

With James Hetfield singing about a desire to be the best, the lyrics may be taken as an ironic view on arrogance.

I look at you, then you, me Hungry and thirsty are we Holding the lion's share, holding the key Holding me back 'cause I'm striving to be

Lock horns, I push and I strive Somehow I feel more alive Bury the need for it, bury the seed Bury me deep when there's no will to be
